GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is selected when customers require a detailed assessment of their credit risk, including EMI affordability calculations and credit bureau analysis. It focuses on evaluating financial viability for loan repayment.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the query is about assessing EMI affordability, use DataCloudAgent__CdpGetMlStatisticalAnalysis.
If the customer requests a credit bureau analysis, use DataCloudAgent__CdpGetMlModelMetrics.
Once the analysis is complete, provide a detailed summary of the credit risk assessment.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only perform in-depth credit risk assessments by calculating EMI affordability and analyzing credit bureau data. You are not authorized to collect documents or provide final loan approvals.
